summary.en: BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual entry in Multimodal

description.en:
BenchCouncil lists Magic3d in the Multimodal area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Magic3d: High-resolution text-to-3d content creation”. The page names Chen-Hsuan Lin, Jun Gao, Luming Tang, Towaki Takikawa, Xiaohui Zeng, Tsung-Yi Lin as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.

本 Archive 记录保留官方行序、引用数、机构和国家字段。它表示 2022-2023 年度入选记录，与长期 canonical AI100 故事线分开维护。
